api.name: API Structures sanitaires
api.description:
Version 2 : ajoute statut, nombre de lits, téléphone, services et date d'ouverture, regroupe région et ville dans `localisation`, ajoute le filtre `statut` et le tri `tri`.

Accès via la gateway Gravitee : `http://localhost:8082/sante/structures/v2` avec l'en-tête `X-Gravitee-Api-Key`.

pages.name: Swagger
pages.content:
openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: API Structures sanitaires
  version: 2.0.0
  description: 'Version 2 : ajoute statut, nombre de lits, téléphone, services et
    date d''ouverture, regroupe région et ville dans `localisation`, ajoute le filtre
    `statut` et le tri `tri`.


    Accès via la gateway Gravitee : `http://localhost:8082/sante/structures/v2` avec
    l''en-tête `X-Gravitee-Api-Key`.'
  contact:
    name: SI Groupe 2 — IBAM 2026
paths:
  /structures:
    get:
      summary: Lister les structures (paginé, triable)
      operationId: list_structures_api_v2_structures_get
      parameters:
      - name: page
        in: query
        required: false
        schema:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
          description: Numéro de page, à partir de 1
          default: 1
          title: Page
        description: Numéro de page, à partir de 1
      - name: size
        in: query
        required: false
        schema:
          type: integer
          maximum: 100
          minimum: 1
          description: Nombre d'éléments par page (1 à 100)
          default: 10
          title: Size
        description: Nombre d'éléments par page (1 à 100)
      - name: tri
        in: query
        required: false
        schema:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Tri'
          description: 'Tri : id, nom, -nom, lits, -lits'
          default: id
        description: 'Tri : id, nom, -nom, lits, -lits'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Successful Response
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/PageV2'
        '400':
          description: Paramètres invalides (VALIDATION_ERROR, MISSING_CRITERIA)
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
        '503':
          description: Base de données indisponible (DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE)
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
        '500':
          description: Erreur interne (INTERNAL_ERROR)
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
        '401':
          description: Clé d'API absente, invalide ou souscription fermée (renvoyé
            par la gateway Gravitee)
          content:
            application/json:
              example:
                message: Unauthorized
                http_status_code: 401
        '429':
          description: Limite de requêtes ou quota du plan dépassé (renvoyé par la
            gateway Gravitee)
          content:
            application/json:
              example:
                message: Rate limit exceeded ! You reach the limit of 5 requests per
                  10 seconds
                http_status_code: 429
      tags:
      - Structures sanitaires
      security:
      - ApiKeyGravitee: []
  /structures/search:
    get:
      summary: Rechercher des structures (paginé, triable)
      description: 'Au moins un critère est obligatoire. Nouveau en v2 : filtre `statut`.'
      operationId: search_structures_api_v2_structures_search_get
      parameters:
      - name: q
        in: query
        required: false
        schema:
          anyOf:
          - type: string
            minLength: 2
            maxLength: 100
          - type: 'null'
          description: Texte recherché dans le nom ou le code
          title: Q
        description: Texte recherché dans le nom ou le code
      - name: type
        in: query
        required: false
        schema:
          anyOf:
          - $ref: '#/components/schemas/TypeStructure'
          - type: 'null'
          title: Type
      - name: statut
        in: query
        required: false
        schema:
          anyOf:
          - $ref: '#/components/schemas/Statut'
          - type: 'null'
          description: PUBLIC ou PRIVE
          title: Statut
        description: PUBLIC ou PRIVE
      - name: region
        in: query
        required: false
        schema:
          anyOf:
          - type: string
            maxLength: 60
          - type: 'null'
          title: Region
      - name: ville
        in: query
        required: false
        schema:
          anyOf:
          - type: string
            maxLength: 80
          - type: 'null'
          title: Ville
      - name: tri
        in: query
        required: false
        schema:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Tri'
          default: id
      - name: page
        in: query
        required: false
        schema:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
          default: 1
          title: Page
      - name: size
        in: query
        required: false
        schema:
          type: integer
          maximum: 100
          minimum: 1
          default: 10
          title: Size
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Successful Response
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/PageV2'
        '400':
          description: Paramètres invalides (VALIDATION_ERROR, MISSING_CRITERIA)
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
        '503':
          description: Base de données indisponible (DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE)
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
        '500':
          description: Erreur interne (INTERNAL_ERROR)
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
        '401':
          description: Clé d'API absente, invalide ou souscription fermée (renvoyé
            par la gateway Gravitee)
          content:
            application/json:
              example:
                message: Unauthorized
                http_status_code: 401
        '429':
          description: Limite de requêtes ou quota du plan dépassé (renvoyé par la
            gateway Gravitee)
          content:
            application/json:
              example:
                message: Rate limit exceeded ! You reach the limit of 5 requests per
                  10 seconds
                http_status_code: 429
      tags:
      - Structures sanitaires
      security:
      - ApiKeyGravitee: []
  /structures/{id}:
    get:
      summary: Obtenir le détail complet d'une structure
      operationId: get_structure_api_v2_structures__id__get
      parameters:
      - name: id
        in: path
        required: true
        schema:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
          description: Identifiant technique de la structure
          title: Id
        description: Identifiant technique de la structure
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Successful Response
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/StructureV2'
        '404':
          description: Structure inexistante (STRUCTURE_NOT_FOUND)
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
        '400':
          description: Paramètres invalides (VALIDATION_ERROR, MISSING_CRITERIA)
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
        '503':
          description: Base de données indisponible (DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE)
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
        '500':
          description: Erreur interne (INTERNAL_ERROR)
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
        '401':
          description: Clé d'API absente, invalide ou souscription fermée (renvoyé
            par la gateway Gravitee)
          content:
            application/json:
              example:
                message: Unauthorized
                http_status_code: 401
        '429':
          description: Limite de requêtes ou quota du plan dépassé (renvoyé par la
            gateway Gravitee)
          content:
            application/json:
              example:
                message: Rate limit exceeded ! You reach the limit of 5 requests per
                  10 seconds
                http_status_code: 429
      tags:
      - Structures sanitaires
      security:
      - ApiKeyGravitee: []
components:
  schemas:
    ErrorDetail:
      properties:
        champ:
          type: string
          title: Champ
          examples:
          - size
        message:
          type: string
          title: Message
          examples:
          - Input should be less than or equal to 100
      type: object
      required:
      - champ
      - message
      title: ErrorDetail
    ErrorResponse:
      properties:
        status:
          type: integer
          title: Status
          examples:
          - 404
        code:
          type: string
          title: Code
          examples:
          - STRUCTURE_NOT_FOUND
        message:
          type: string
          title: Message
          examples:
          - Aucune structure avec l'id 999
        details:
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorDetail'
          type: array
          title: Details
          default: []
      type: object
      required:
      - status
      - code
      - message
      title: ErrorResponse
    Localisation:
      properties:
        region:
          type: string
          title: Region
          examples:
          - Centre
        ville:
          type: string
          title: Ville
          examples:
          - Ouagadougou
      type: object
      required:
      - region
      - ville
      title: Localisation
    PageV2:
      properties:
        page:
          type: integer
          title: Page
        size:
          type: integer
          title: Size
        total:
          type: integer
          title: Total
        pages:
          type: integer
          title: Pages
        items:
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/StructureV2'
          type: array
          title: Items
      type: object
      required:
      - page
      - size
      - total
      - pages
      - items
      title: PageV2
    Statut:
      type: string
      enum:
      - PUBLIC
      - PRIVE
      title: Statut
    StructureV2:
      properties:
        id:
          type: integer
          title: Id
          examples:
          - 1
        code:
          type: string
          title: Code
          examples:
          - CHU-CEN-001
        nom:
          type: string
          title: Nom
          examples:
          - CHU Fictif de Ouagadougou Nord
        type:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/TypeStructure'
        statut:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Statut'
        localisation:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Localisation'
        nombre_lits:
          type: integer
          title: Nombre Lits
          examples:
          - 620
        telephone:
          anyOf:
          - type: string
          - type: 'null'
          title: Telephone
          examples:
          - +226 25 00 10 01
        services:
          items:
            type: string
          type: array
          title: Services
          examples:
          - - urgences
            - maternite
        date_ouverture:
          anyOf:
          - type: string
            format: date
          - type: 'null'
          title: Date Ouverture
      type: object
      required:
      - id
      - code
      - nom
      - type
      - statut
      - localisation
      - nombre_lits
      - services
      title: StructureV2
    Tri:
      type: string
      enum:
      - id
      - nom
      - -nom
      - lits
      - -lits
      title: Tri
    TypeStructure:
      type: string
      enum:
      - CHU
      - CHR
      - CMA
      - CSPS
      - CLINIQUE
      title: TypeStructure
  securitySchemes:
    ApiKeyGravitee:
      type: apiKey
      in: header
      name: X-Gravitee-Api-Key
servers:
- url: http://structures-api:8000/api/v2
  description: Backend (réseau Docker, cible de la gateway)
